title: Consistency of the Bayesian Information Criterion for Model Selection in Exploratory Factor Analysis
summary: We study model selection by the Bayesian information criterion (BIC) in fixed-dimensional exploratory factor analysis over a fixed finite family of compact covariance classes. Our main result shows that the BIC is strongly consistent for the pseudo-true factor order under misspecification, provided that all globally optimal models share a common pseudo-true covariance set, the population Gaussian criterion has a local quadratic margin away from that set, and the BIC complexity counts are order-separating at the pseudo-true order.
